decisions.reason: The burner component draws directly on the firm's core gas-radiant know-how and supports its established heater range, so the firm can maintain and improve it at little cost.
This flagship multi-model electric infrared panel line extends the firm's infrared expertise toward electrification, and in-house R&D can keep refining it.
The halogen infrared heater is a niche item but sits close to existing infrared knowledge and costs little to keep within the broad range, and there is no evidence that would justify dropping it.
This multi-model industrial hall heater line serves the firm's core large-hall market, where its accumulated experience and service network let it interpret field results and improve the product.
The hydrogen-ready dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with documented real-world operation, builds on core gas-radiant expertise, and fits the firm's low-carbon direction.
